Chandigarh is undergoing rapid urbanisation and the
transformation has been holistic and all-inclusive. Over the years,
the city has made remarkable progress in terms of physical
infrastructure and business environment and has emerged as an
economic growth centre with one of the highest per capita incomes
in India.

Ample opportunities are available to work and grow in the IT, BPO
and pharmaceutical sectors in the region. It has proven to be a
magnet for potential employers and employees.

The open hand is the official emblem of Chandigarh; it symbolises
the city's philosophy of being “open to give” and “open to receive”.
Chandigarh has seen the growth of some major start-ups over the
last few years. The city has kept pace with the ever evolving
education sector to become the one-stop destination for all
education needs. This makes Chandigarh ideal for students who
wish to enjoy the blend of rich culture of city life and the peaceful
environment that this city offers.

Chandigarh is easily accessible from Delhi, Haryana, Punjab,

Sukhna Lake

Immerse yourself in the tranquility of
Sukhna Lake Chandigarh, a picturesque
man-made lake that offers a serene
escape from urban life. Located at the
foothills of the Shivalik Hills, this popular
spot, also known as Chandigarh Jheel, is
an ideal destination for nature lovers and
adventure enthusiasts alike.

The Taj Mahal

The Taj Mahal needs no introduction, yet there
is a lot to know about the much-admired
Wonder of the world. The pristine white
marble monument flaunts its beautiful
structure like nothing else and draws
admirers of its beauty from around the world.
The Taj Mahal is more than a tomb! It’s a story
of India’s past, and architectural heritage.

Rock Garden

This is one of the prime attractions and
must visit place in Chandigarh. A perfect
destination for art lovers. Nek Chand
started building this near Sukhna lake in
the year 1957 in his free timelsecretly). The
garden is divided into 3 sections each one
having different and specific structures.

The Lotus Temple

The Lotus Temple is a Baha’i House of
Worship in Kalkaji, New Delhi, India. It was
completed in December 1986. Notable for
its lotus-like shape, it has become a
prominent attraction in the city. Like all
Baha’i Houses of Worship, the Lotus
Temple is open to all people, regardless of
religion or any other qualification.

LORE IN INDIA

India Gate

India Gate, a 42-meter war memorial in New
Delhi, honors 70,000 Indian soldiers who died
in World War I. It symbolizes sacrifice,
patriotism, and national pride, attracting
visitors worldwide.

Hawa Mahal

Hawa Mahal in Jaipur, built in 1799 by
Maharaja Sawai Pratap Singh, features 953
jharokhas. Known as the “Palace of Winds,”
it allowed royal women to view street life
while remaining unseen.

Gateway Of India

The Gateway of India, built in 1924 in
Mumbai, is a majestic Indo-Saracenic arch
overlooking the Arabian Sea. It
commemorates King George V’s visit and
symbolizes India’s colonial past and heritage.

Banaras

Banaras Ghats, lining the sacred Ganges in
Varanasi, are vibrant steps for rituals,
prayers, and cremations. They reflect
spirituality, culture, and timeless heritage,
attracting pilgrims, tourists, and seekers
from across the world.

OVERVIEW OF

CHITKARA UNIVERSITY
AND ITS INTERNATIONAL
ENGAGEMENT

WE ARE AT THE FOREFRONT OF INTERNATIONAL ENGAGEMENT & PARTNERSHIPS

Name any part of the World, and we send and receive students. From North America to Europe,
the Middle East to Southeast Asia, from Japan & Korea to down under Australia, our students go
everywhere, and we welcome their students to Chitkara University. Chandigarh is the most well-
planned, secure, and non-polluted Indian city in the foothills of the Himalayas, where our
international students and faculty love to keep coming back.

Chitkara University offers a diverse range of programs in Engineering, Business, Pharmacy, Health
Sciences, Design, Media, Hospitality, Education, Law, and more. With a student-centric approach,
the university ensures holistic development by combining academic rigor with practical exposure,
entrepreneurship, and skill enhancement.

Our experiential learning is not just limited to academic education but a holistic one that engages
and rejuvenates your mind and body alike. From Yoga to Meditation, trekking and soul searching
trips in the upper reaches of the Himalayas, students experience a vibe and energy of India that it
has represented for centuries. Besides, you will be welcomed to learn and indulge in vibrant and
lip-smacking Indian cuisines from diverse parts of India, and create some lifelong relationships with
our community that could be a bedrock support for life.

You can come to us for a short mobility or a semester or global internships, we abide by our motto
‘Athithi Devo Bhava’, which simply translates to our guests are our Gods. Come, experience our
Hospitality and grow in your mind and spirit at Chitkara University

knowledge, cross-cultural skills, and networks for global success. The dedicated
International Affairs team supports accommodation, integration, and engagement, making
every student's journey enriching and memorable.
